theorems.name: Submission.ind_rs_tauAction_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n), 0 < r → tauAction n M θ ξ (fun y => (r ^ n)⁻¹ • ω (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) = tauAction n ((fun y => r⁻¹ • (y - x)) '' M) (fun z => θ (x + r • z)) (fun z => ξ (x + r • z)) ω
